name: (02) Thaumaturgy (Path of the Vine of Dionysus) — 1 Basic — Methyskein

system.description: By making physical contact with her target, the thaumaturge causes the victim to behave and appear intoxicated for one scene, suffering a one-Trait penalty on challenges involving Dexterity or Intelligence and acting drunk. If used on the same mortal or ghoul three nights running, the victim becomes addicted to the euphoria and may suffer penalties without a nightly "fix." Kindred who begin this path automatically lose one permanent Willpower Trait as they become addicted to its hedonistic pleasures. This path retests with the Occult Ability.
system.discipline: Thaumaturgy (Path of the Vine of Dionysus)
